question: Tell me about wifi.
expected_answer: Complimentary high-speed Wi-Fi is available throughout the hotel for all registered guests. Guests can connect using the network GrandHorizon_Guest and enter the access credentials provided during check-in. For technical assistance or connectivity issues, guests may contact the Front Desk at any time.

question: Tell me about spa.
expected_answer: The Serenity Spa operates daily from 10:00 AM to 9:00 PM. Guests can choose from massages, facials, body treatments, and wellness therapies. Advance appointments are recommended to ensure availability. Guests are advised to arrive at least 15 minutes before their scheduled treatment.

question: Tell me about deluxe room.
expected_answer: The Deluxe Room offers a comfortable stay with a king-size bed, air conditioning, a smart TV, complimentary Wi-Fi, tea and coffee-making facilities, and a work desk. Each room includes an attached bathroom with premium toiletries and a hairdryer. The room accommodates up to two adults and one child. Daily housekeeping is included in the room rate.

question: Tell me about visitor policy.
expected_answer: Visitors are permitted between 8:00 AM and 10:00 PM after registering at the Front Desk with a valid photo ID. Overnight visitors are not allowed unless officially added to the room reservation and applicable charges have been settled. Hotel management reserves the right to deny entry if security concerns arise.

question: Tell me about vegan menu.
expected_answer: The hotel offers a variety of vegetarian and vegan dishes across all dining outlets. Guests can choose from salads, soups, plant-based curries, pasta, rice bowls, and dairy-free desserts. Customized vegan meals can also be prepared upon request. Please inform the restaurant staff of your dietary preferences before ordering.

question: Can I store my luggage at the hotel?
expected_answer: Guests may store their luggage securely at the reception before check-in or after check-out at no additional cost on the same day. Long-term luggage storage may be available upon request and is subject to space availability. The hotel recommends that guests avoid storing valuable items such as cash, jewellery, passports, or electronic devices in stored luggage.

question: Tell me about extra bed.
expected_answer: Extra beds are available upon request for selected room categories and are subject to availability. Additional charges apply per night and include bedding and basic amenities. The hotel recommends requesting an extra bed during the reservation process to ensure availability before arrival.

question: Tell me about executive room.
expected_answer: Executive Rooms are designed for business and leisure travelers seeking additional comfort. These rooms feature a king-size bed, ergonomic workspace, high-speed Wi-Fi, smart TV, minibar, coffee machine, and city views. Guests staying in Executive Rooms also receive complimentary access to the Executive Lounge during operating hours.

question: What should I do if I lose an item?
expected_answer: Items found within the hotel premises are recorded and securely stored by the housekeeping department. Guests who believe they have misplaced personal belongings should contact the Front Desk with a detailed description of the item. Unclaimed items are generally retained for 90 days before being disposed of in accordance with hotel policy.

question: What is the hotel's check-out policy?
expected_answer: Late check-out is available upon request and depends on room availability. Guests checking out between 11:00 AM and 2:00 PM may be charged a partial room rate. Check-outs after 2:00 PM are generally charged as a full night's stay. Guests are advised to contact the Front Desk at least one day in advance to request a late check-out.

question: Tell me about restaurant.
expected_answer: The Horizon Restaurant serves breakfast, lunch, and dinner daily. Lunch is available from 12:30 PM to 3:00 PM, while dinner is served between 7:00 PM and 10:30 PM. Reservations are recommended during weekends and public holidays. Smart casual attire is encouraged for all guests dining in the restaurant.

question: Tell me about food allergy.
expected_answer: Guests with food allergies or dietary restrictions are encouraged to inform the restaurant staff before placing an order. Menu items may contain allergens such as nuts, dairy, gluten, eggs, or seafood. The culinary team will make every reasonable effort to accommodate special dietary requirements while maintaining food safety standards.

question: Tell me about medical assistance.
expected_answer: Basic first aid assistance is available at the Front Desk at all times. In case of medical emergencies, the hotel can arrange immediate transportation to the nearest hospital or contact an on-call doctor. Guests requiring regular medication or special medical support are advised to inform the hotel during check-in for appropriate assistance.

question: Tell me about room amenities.
expected_answer: Every guest room is equipped with complimentary Wi-Fi, air conditioning, a smart television, electronic safe, telephone, minibar, tea and coffee-making facilities, bottled drinking water, premium toiletries, fresh towels, and a hairdryer. Additional amenities such as an iron, ironing board, or extra pillows can be requested through housekeeping.

question: Tell me about taxi booking.
expected_answer: The Concierge Desk can arrange taxis, airport transfers, car rentals, and local sightseeing transportation. Guests are encouraged to book transportation in advance during weekends and holidays. Fare estimates will be provided before confirming the reservation, and payment can be made directly to the service provider or added to the room bill where applicable.

question: Tell me about gym.
expected_answer: The fitness center is open 24 hours for registered hotel guests. Guests are required to wear appropriate workout attire and athletic footwear while using the gym. Equipment should be cleaned after use with the sanitizing wipes provided. Guests under 16 years of age must be supervised by an adult.

question: Does the hotel provide airport pickup service?
expected_answer: Airport transportation is available for guests upon prior reservation. Pick-up and drop-off services operate throughout the day and are charged according to the vehicle selected. Guests should provide their flight details at least 24 hours before arrival to ensure timely service. Hotel representatives will coordinate the pickup schedule and assist guests upon arrival.

question: What is the hotel's check-out policy?
expected_answer: Standard check-out time is 11:00 AM. Guests wishing to extend their stay should contact the Front Desk before check-out. Late check-out may be available based on occupancy and may incur additional charges. Before leaving, guests are requested to return the room key and settle any outstanding charges such as minibar usage, laundry, or room service.

question: Tell me about business center.
expected_answer: The Business Centre is open daily from 8:00 AM to 8:00 PM. Facilities include desktop computers, high-speed internet access, printing, scanning, photocopying, and meeting workstations. Guests requiring administrative assistance may request support from the Business Centre staff during operating hours.

question: Tell me about cancellation.
expected_answer: Guests may cancel their reservation up to 48 hours before the scheduled check-in date without any cancellation charges. Cancellations made within 48 hours of arrival may incur a one-night room charge. Refund processing timelines depend on the original payment method. Special promotional and non-refundable bookings are not eligible for cancellation.

question: What is the hotel's check-in policy?
expected_answer: Standard check-in time is 2:00 PM. Guests are required to present a valid government-issued photo ID and the booking confirmation at the reception. A refundable security deposit may be collected during check-in, depending on the room category. Early check-in is subject to room availability and hotel policies. Guests arriving before the standard check-in time may request luggage storage free of charge while waiting for their room.

question: Tell me about ev charging.
expected_answer: Electric vehicle charging stations are available within the hotel's parking area. Guests may use the charging facility based on availability. Charging fees are calculated according to electricity consumption and are payable during check-out. Guests should contact the Front Desk to reserve a charging slot if required.

question: Tell me about baby crib.
expected_answer: Complimentary baby cribs are available for infants under two years of age, subject to availability. Guests are encouraged to request a crib while making their reservation or before arrival. The hotel provides clean bedding for every crib to ensure the comfort and safety of young children.

question: Tell me about room service.
expected_answer: Room service is available 24 hours a day for all in-house guests. A selection of Indian, Continental, and international dishes can be ordered using the in-room telephone. Estimated delivery time is 25 to 40 minutes, depending on the order and occupancy. Additional service charges may apply for certain premium menu items.

question: Tell me about laundry.
expected_answer: Laundry services are available daily from 8:00 AM to 8:00 PM. Guests may place their laundry in the designated laundry bag provided in the room and contact housekeeping for collection. Regular laundry is typically returned within 24 hours, while express service is available for an additional charge.
